capabilities: Track build, avoidance, and zero-goal habits on daily to annual cadences
Import habit data from HTTP API endpoints and an Android companion app
View heat-map calendars, configurable dashboards, and per-habit analytics
Embed live loggers and dashboards in notes via codeblocks
Transfer habit files between desktop and mobile over local Wi-Fi
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README warns that local peer sync has not undergone an independent cryptographic assessment and that shared challenges are an exploratory roadmap item, not a committed feature.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track habits or combine manual logging with data from services like Health Connect, GitHub, or Duolingo in one place.

relations.evidence: The companion app reads permission-granted Android Health Connect metrics (sleep, hydration, steps, nutrition calories, exercise)
Health Connect: Sleep duration, hydration volume, daily steps, nutrition calories, and exercise minutes.
Connected APIs: GitHub contributions, Monkeytype typing duration, and Duolingo streak tracking.
